newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says 3rd qtr steel profit soars.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says 3rd qtr steel profit soars.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Friday that its steel division achieved a net profit after tax of A$72 million in the 1996/97 third quarter ending February 28, a 63.6 percent rise on the year-ago result.

"Major factors affecting the quarterly profit result were lower costs due to an improved manufacturing performance, reduced employee levels and the inclusion of Tubemakers result, partly offset by lower export prices," BHP said in a statement accompanying its third quarter profit result.

It said raw steel production for the third quarter was three percent lower at 2.045 million tonnes, with the slight fall due to an unscheduled outage at Port Kembla's number five blast furnace just south of Sydney.
